description: Implementation of a high-performance timer management system with timer wheel, supporting create, start, stop, destroy, and expiry callbacks, using lock-free queues and intrusive linked lists.

classes.name: timer_update_signaller
classes.description: Manages a lock-free queue of timer update commands from front-end to back-end.

classes.name: backend_channel
classes.description: Channels timer commands between front-end and back-end, minimizing signaling.

classes.name: frontend_handle
classes.description: Represents a timer instance on the front-end, managing its state and callbacks.

classes.name: timer_manager::manager_impl
classes.description: Core implementation of the timer manager, handling timer lifecycle, wheel, and command processing.

methods.name: handle_timer_commands
methods.description: Processes queued timer commands from front-end.

methods.name: try_stop_timer_backend
methods.description: Attempts to stop a timer, handling expiry if needed.

methods.name: trigger_timeout_handling
methods.description: Dispatches timer expiry callback to the front-end executor.

methods.name: handle_postponed_timeouts
methods.description: Retries timeout callbacks that failed previously.

methods.name: create_frontend_timer
methods.description: Creates or reuses a front-end timer handle.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Advances the timer system by one tick, processing expirations.
